view.name: Previous results list
view.description: List of past game results saved on the device, grouped by date, each entry summarizing chains.

regions.label: Centered h2 'Your Previous Results' with subtitle and hr separator
Date-grouped bordered list-group of buttons, each a past game summarized by time and its first word chains
Credit line 'Drawphone by Tanner Krewson' and 'View on GitHub' link

evidence.quote: 08:16 PM: minion to hot dog, slither to noodle, etc.
evidence.note: Each row is a button summarizing one game; clicking it on the live page replaces the list with a 'Results #1' detail view showing each word and drawing in the chain
It's sorted by time, but it's an archive of saved artifacts you open, not a log of events
Items are rows in a list group that share borders, not separate cards

structure.layout: single narrow centered column (452px) with heading, long date-grouped list of results, exit button and footer

aesthetics.typography: Pangolin (handwritten-style rounded sans) used for everything: headings, list items, buttons, footer
aesthetics.typeScale: Small range: 32px h2 title, 20px Exit button, 16px everywhere else; all weight 400

notes: A Bootstrap list-group look: grouped buttons with 1px #cccccc borders and 4px radius on the outer corners, bare date labels above each group, everything centered. The handwritten Pangolin font is the only personality, and there's no color apart from blue links. Item text is a generated summary built as 'HH:MM PM: firstWord to lastGuess, firstWord to lastGuess, etc.' On the live page, clicking an item swaps the content in place for the full results chain (words and drawings on a bordered square canvas).
